Industry/name for symbols that are DELISTED, hence absent from dash_slim.bin's currently-listed universe -- which is the only source build_sf_data.py has for meta.ind, so every one of them came out ind='Unknown', name=<symbol>. That is not a classification gap, it is a survivorship gap: the scrape only covers live scrips. 2,008 of the live bin's 4,445 symbols are affected; the 26 here are the ones that reached Nifty 500 membership between 2020-01 and 2026-06 and so showed up as holes on the coverage matrix (industry 857 cells).
SOURCE: BSE ComHeadernew/w -> IndustryNew, the SAME field fetch_sectors.py reads for live scrips, so the vocabulary is identical by construction and needs no cross-map (verified: RELIANCE 500325 returns 'Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels', which is exactly what dash_slim stores).
IDENTITY GATE: the BSE code came from Moneycontrol's autosuggest and was accepted only when the ISIN matched ours -- exactly, or on the 7-char issuer prefix where a face-value change reissued it (runbook §95). Then BSE's OWN returned ISIN had to confirm it again. A name match was never enough: MC's top hit for HDFC is HDFC *Bank* and for HEXAWARE is HEXT, both different securities.
Consumed by build_sf_data.py when the live universe has no row for a symbol.
